name: Gati
author: kanthi
description: Gati (गति) — A dynamic focus timer widget for the Omarchy status bar representing momentum, flow, and focus.

barWidget.description: Focus timer with session counts, break alerts, and popout controls.

schema.label: Workflow preset mode
schema.description: Selected focus timer workflow preset (classic, deep, ultra, custom).

schema.label: Short break duration (minutes)
schema.description: Length of short breaks between sessions.

schema.label: Long break duration (minutes)
schema.description: Length of long break after completing set interval.

schema.label: Sessions before long break
schema.description: Number of focus sessions before triggering a long break.

schema.label: Show timer in top bar
schema.description: Toggle countdown timer text next to the G icon in the bar.

schema.label: Reset daily stats automatically
schema.description: Automatically reset daily focus counter and session blocks at midnight.

schema.label: Audio sound cues
schema.description: Play acoustic bells and sound cues on session start and completion.

schema.label: Sound volume percentage
schema.description: Volume level for audio notification chimes (0-100).

schema.label: Sound theme
schema.description: Acoustic sound theme for timer alerts (zen, crystal, marimba).

schema.label: Desktop notifications
schema.description: Send a desktop notification toast 10 seconds before each break starts.

schema.label: Auto-start breaks
schema.description: Automatically transition into rest breaks when a focus session ends.

schema.label: Auto-start focus sessions
schema.description: Automatically start next focus session when a break countdown ends.
